title: Drunk Wife Doesn’t Remember Killing Husband
description:
Bodycam footage shows Wisconsin deputies responding to an emergency call after a man reported seeing a body in the roadway. Deputies found Mary Jane Terry, 50, frantic and drunk at the scene. That’s when police discovered her husband, Donald Britten Jr., was the man lying in the street. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
